findings.title: ‘Will I get taller?’: Gaza’s children suffer stunting amid war, blockade
findings.location: Nasser Hospital, Khan Younis, and Ministry of Health laboratories in Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Children with growth disorders; Nasser Hospital endocrinologist Hani Sayed Zuhair reports clinic demand has increased from roughly 15–20 patients per session before the war to 30–40 or more, and public-sector growth hormone stimulation testing is unavailable; private testing is limited by supply shortages and costly. This is a newly documented current service constraint, not a new shutdown.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Growth hormone stimulation tests are unavailable in Ministry of Health laboratories
findings.source_type: Established media field reporting with named specialist interview

bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Interview and onset dates unknown. Prewar comparison is not an hourly change or population-level incidence measure. Older UNICEF survey figures excluded. No independent confirmation of laboratory availability.
